overview: Based on the published agenda, the Kronenwetter Plan Commission was scheduled to hold a public hearing and vote on a text amendment to Chapter 508 of the village ordinances regarding septic tank use in the sewer system area, and to consider several development and infrastructure matters including a subdivision plat review and stormwater maintenance agreement.

discussions.item: Text Amendment of Chapter 508 - Water and Sewers
discussions.body: The Plan Commission was scheduled to hold a public hearing on proposed amendments to Chapter 508 subsection 508-37 regarding septic tanks. The amendments were set to establish criteria allowing septic tanks as exceptions in the village's sewer system area, where they are currently prohibited.
The Commission was scheduled to discuss ongoing zoning code review matters as part of old business. Details regarding specific aspects of the code under review were not provided in the agenda.
The Plan Commission was set to take action on septic tank ordinance matters, which relates to the text amendment being considered and was expected to be addressed as new business.

The Commission was scheduled to review the final plat and draft development agreement for the Green Tree Trails subdivision project. This was set for discussion and possible action under new business.

The Plan Commission was scheduled to consider a resolution authorizing a stormwater maintenance agreement with 2027 Wausau LLC for a distribution center located at 1619 County Road XX. This was expected to involve discussion and possible action.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda with a 15-minute limit total and three minutes per person, with possible time extensions at the presiding officer's discretion.
